title: CheckpointMetadata
description: An immutable description of a training checkpoint. Its `checkpoint_id` is a content hash of the record with the `checkpoint_id` field itself excluded (see schemas/CANONICALIZATION.md).

checkpoint_id.description: Computed content id, format 'sha256:<hex>'. EXCLUDED from the canonical hash preimage; treat as output only.

run_id.description: Identifier of the training run this checkpoint belongs to.

step.description: Global training step at which the checkpoint was taken.

epoch.description: Epoch index at which the checkpoint was taken (optional).

digest.description: Content digest of the checkpoint payload, format 'sha256:<hex>'.

metrics.description: Snapshot of metrics recorded at this checkpoint.

revision_id.description: Reference to the TrainingRevision active at this checkpoint, format 'sha256:<hex>' (optional).
